messages:
Ava: Thanks everyone for attending the all-hands reliability segment. Leaving a short follow-up thread to confirm RCA links and action owners. Pls flag anything missing.

Tyler: I've uploaded the RCA here: https://redwood.internal/rca/INC-2026-07. I can own the autoscaler flaps follow-ups (runbook update + smoke tests). ETA: end of week.

Jana: I'll take the incident-detection threshold sims and verification. Running sims tonight, will post numbers tomorrow morning.

Leo: Quick question on SLOs: leadership said no customer-facing SLO changes now, right? Only internal alert threshold experiments?

Ava: Correct. Do not change public SLOs. Mark alert threshold tweaks as experimental in the roadmap and add a note that rollbacks are automatic on degradation.

Olivia: I added a verification column to the follow-up spreadsheet in the folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1-reliability-followups. Sheet name: post-allhands-actions.

Tyler: Example smoke test I'll add to the sheet:
```
# smoke test
ab -n 200 -c 10 https://api.redwood.ai/v1/health
# expect p99 < 350ms
```

Jana: For the alert experiment I propose 48h in staging + 24h in prod with automated rollback if error-rate delta > 0.2%. Thoughts? :thinking_face: 

Leo: Sounds good. I'll add a dashboard tile for error-rate delta and a temporary pager rule tied to the canary. ETA ~48h.

Ava: OK. Engineering leadership will review after the combined 72h canary. Tag me on changes.

sre-bot: INC-2026-07 RCA uploaded by @Tyler at 2167894400 — artifacts: logs, flamegraphs, heapdumps.

Tyler: Runbook PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/reliability/pull/482. Assigning @Ava for review and @Leo for dashboard changes.

Olivia: Owners: please add expected verification dates in the spreadsheet by EOD so PMs can get the export.

Ava: Action summary for copy-paste: - Tyler: runbook + smoke tests (ETA EOW) - Jana: threshold sims + verification (ETA next morning) - Leo: dashboard tile + pager rule (ETA 48h) - Olivia: verification column maintained & PM export (ETA EOD)

Tyler: I'll post a short note in #eng-sre with the smoke test commands and link to the PR for visibility.

Jana: If anyone can pair during the staging canary on Thursday morning, ping me. Would appreciate a second pair of eyes.

Ava: Thanks all. If blockers surface escalate to me or drop them in #release-war-room. Closing this thread once all ETAs are recorded. :white_check_mark:
